newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels bourse to smooth Bel-20 re-weighting.
newsitem.headline: Brussels bourse to smooth Bel-20 re-weighting.

text.p: The Brussels bourse announced measures on Thursday to avoid excessive volume and price volatility on September 20 when it changes the weighting of the Bel-20 index components at the close of trading that day.
"The Bourse has taken a series of measures which aim to guarantee that transactions are carried out calmly in Bel-20 stocks on that date," the Bourse said in a statement.
It said that on September 20 trading on the continuous market would be interrupted at 1515 local (1315 GMT) and return to a state of pre-opening trading.
"Every trader will put in orders and amounts he wants to do at closing," bourse management committee member Anne Vleminckx said.
Between 1540 (1340 GMT) and 1600 (1400 GMT) will be a period of intervention when orders can be raised in terms of price or volume.

At 1600 (1400 GMT) the bourse trading system calculates final closing prices, and from then to the usual closing time of 1630 (1430 GMT) players can only trade at these closing prices, the bourse said.
